title: 75-28 不同softness共用的未圆角墙面
current_evidence_scope: 第35项固定相同两平面与A/B接触线：d=13 mm。三档显式G2代理的接头、BREP/STEP/FreeCAD共12份独立验证通过；原生R13及内部C2控制仅G0/G1通过，接头G2失败。0.1/1/10是原图形态档位，本地α=.03/.30/.49不是已认证的Parasolid数值softness law；外观待人工核对。

generic_oracles.quantity: support geometry + finite domains + topology class
generic_oracles.method: Compare independently sampled supports/boundaries, dimensions, placements and material-side occupancy; account for allowed face subdivision. No widening, thickening or pruning source faces.

generic_oracles.expected: exactly requested faces/edges, no silent reselection
generic_oracles.method: Resolve geometric/topological selectors after import; record candidates and expected match count; ambiguous target stops score.
Native checks plus independent seam and occupancy/orientation tests. Save raw BRep even on failure.
Evaluate shared edge and both support surfaces using actual pcurves; sample endpoints/interior and adaptive extrema.
Use consistent material/sheet orientation and evaluate normals at actual seam; end caps only exempt from G1 if declared, never from G0.

target_change: At identical contacts and end tangents, vary G2 transition shape: low softness close to rounded chamfer, high softness close to L; all actual support joins remain G2.
must_preserve: Original two plane sheets y0/z0, width20, height18, floor17; no hidden thickness/solid substitution.
A wall contact(x,0,13), B floor contact(x,13,0), x[-10,10], same end tangents for every shape tier.
Original source labels .1/1/10 are not certified equal to SMLib thumbweight or OCC proxy alpha.
No drawn highlight/green plane is counted as new topology.

semantic_target.original_edge: x[-10,10],y=z=0 on sewed open two-face shell
semantic_target.expected_result: open shell with complete transition; face counts may differ legally if boundary/coverage correct

feature_oracles.expected: d13 at all stations and shape tiers
feature_oracles.method: Evaluate real rail coordinates/endpoints at 33+ width stations; if cannot hold contacts record noncomparable_conditions, do not resize input.

feature_oracles.quantity: actual oriented shape operator / normal-section curvature at join
feature_oracles.expected: matches plane zero curvature after G0/G1 passes
feature_oracles.method: Evaluate at actual common pcurve, align normals and corresponding tangent directions. Plane joins require both principal curvatures and sampled normal curvatures→0; inspect end/near-corner separately.

feature_oracles.expected: low near chamfer; high flat near supports and concentrated bend in middle
feature_oracles.method: Use actual constant-x iso sections, arc-length-normalized curvature and midpoint depth; report quantitative differences independently of qualitative image score.

feature_oracles.expected: regular nonselfintersecting transition at all tiers
feature_oracles.method: Check actual sampled derivatives/intersections, especially high shape parameters; a valid shell flag alone is insufficient.
Only certify mapping from actual native Parasolid trials or authoritative numeric law; otherwise score G2/controlled shape only, mark source-numeric gap.

native_paths.evidence: Inspected local wrapper calls SmFilletExecutive::SetFilletParameters -> SmBlendCurveCrossSectionFSG; actual pilot outputs exist
native_paths.expresses: Native G2/shape-control candidate with real same-input and join tests
native_paths.boundary: Requested continuity2 does not prove actual G2. Three-edge corner patches only G1; check independently. thumbweight values are independent SMLib parameters.

native_paths.expresses: Same d13 contact and G1 circular profile
native_paths.boundary: Expected curvature jump1/13 to plane, therefore intentionally fails support G2; do not use C2 internal or native-valid flag to overturn this.

gaps.description: Native Parasolid softness .1/1/10 mapping to SMLib thumbweight has not been certified; geometry-control sweep is runnable but source numeric equivalence remains open.
PDF gives qualitative shape behavior, not exact numerical softness law or original dimensions.

inconsistent_if: R13 circle or internal C2 is called G2 at plane join.
Shapes use different contact locations/support sizes.
Same numeric thumbweight and softness are treated as equivalent without actual comparison.
